title: Lego Black Friday deals 2026 UK: what's a good price?
description: The best Lego deals in the UK right now, what Lego's Black Friday discounts looked like last year, and which sets are retiring before Christmas.
intro:
**Short answer: Lego Black Friday deals are live now, and the best buys today are the Lego Game Boy at £35.99 and the Classic Large Creative Brick Box at £28.99, both at Amazon.** New this afternoon: Amazon has cut the new **Star Wars SMART Play** sets, with **Yoda's Hut at £24.99 (was £59.99)** and **Luke's Red Five X-Wing at £54.99 (was £79.99)**. For bigger sets, Argos has **Icons Concorde at £130 (was £170)** and Amazon has **Neuschwanstein Castle at £189.99** and the **Star Wars Death Star at £808**.

Black Friday is this Friday, 27 November, and Lego's own Black Friday sale runs 27–30 November. These prices were last checked on 24 and 25 November 2026 (latest: 25 November, 2pm); we've removed earlier picks (Hogsmeade, Enterprise, Rivendell) until we can re-check them. For more toy and gift deals, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

body:
## What counts as a good Lego price?

Lego rarely goes below about 30% off on popular sets, so use these rough rules:

- **20% off:** fair, but not special.
- **25–30% off:** a good price, roughly what Lego.com offered on Star Wars, Technic, Icons and Ideas sets at Black Friday 2025.
- **40% off or more:** usually only on older or less popular sets, often ones about to retire.

Which? suggests another check: price per brick. Around 10p a piece is typical. Licensed sets (Star Wars, Harry Potter, Marvel) often cost 11–12p, while Lego's own themes like City and Friends are nearer 7–8p.

For price history, Brickfact and Bricksleuth compare UK retailers, PriceSpy shows a three-month history, and the Keepa or CamelCamelCamel browser extensions show Amazon's.

## When do Lego Black Friday deals start?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**, and Lego's dates on Lego.com are:

- **Insiders Weekend, 21–22 November (now over):** members-only deals and gifts with purchase, with at least 5% back in Insiders points.
- **Black Friday to Cyber Monday, 27–30 November:** discounts on many sets plus gifts with purchase, while stocks last.

Lego.com's discounts are on selected sets only, so compare its price with Amazon and Argos. Membership of Insiders is free.

Amazon, John Lewis, Very and Argos tend to cut prices earlier (this week Amazon and Argos are cheapest on the sets above) and often beat Lego.com on the headline price. Lego.com wins when you want the free gift or points, so add those into the sums on bigger orders.

## Which Lego sets are retiring in 2026?

Lego retires sets in two waves, with the big one at the end of December. Once a set is retired, prices usually go up, not down. Sets reported to be retiring at the end of 2026 include:

- Star Wars UCS Millennium Falcon (75192), Jabba's Sail Barge (75397) and Rebel U-wing (75399)
- Technic Porsche GT4 e-Performance (42176)
- Icons Natural History Museum (10326)
- Botanicals Poinsettia (10370) and Flower Arrangement (10345)
- Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle: Flying Lessons (76447) and The Burrow Collectors' Edition (76437)
- City Police Station (60316)

Lego doesn't publish exact dates and stock can run out early. When we checked PriceSpy on 28 October, the Natural History Museum and Jabba's Sail Barge were no longer listed by any of the big UK retailers, only by eBay and OnBuy sellers. If one of these is on your list, buy it when you see a fair price.

### Are the Lego Black Friday deals any good this year?

Black Friday is already here: prices are live at Amazon and Argos, and many big sets are 10–35% off, about as low as they went last year. If a set you want is at a fair price, buy it, because the best-selling ones can go out of stock in December.

### Where is Lego cheapest in the UK?

Amazon is often cheapest on big sets, but John Lewis, Very, Argos, Sainsbury's and Smyths all undercut it from time to time. Use a price comparison site before buying.

### Is Lego.com ever the cheapest?

Rarely on price alone, but its Black Friday free gifts and double Insiders points can make it the best value on a large order.

### When should I buy Lego advent calendars?

Now, so they arrive by 1 December. They sell out rather than getting cheaper. Our [Lego advent calendar 2026](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) guide lists every set this year and where each is cheapest.

See also our [Pokémon Elite Trainer Box deals UK](/guides/pokemon-elite-trainer-box-deals-uk/) guide [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/), and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
